title: Autonomous Agent Prediction Beta — approach map

competition.description: Build an autonomous CPU-sandbox agent for unseen tabular binary-classification mini-competitions; metric: ROC AUC.
competition.prediction_target: The submitted ZIP must let an agent discover each session's train/test/sample files, write a valid row_id,target probability CSV, submit it, and select a final candidate.
competition.models: Official-agent shell; schema-agnostic sklearn baselines and pick-best portfolios (LR, HGB, RF, ExtraTrees); CatBoost/LightGBM specialists; bounded Gemini Pro feature planning.
competition.finished: Not recorded (workspace records an official deadline of 2026-08-06)
competition.standing: Deadline passed. Best recorded public score: 0.822 (four packages). Final public/private scores and rank: Not recorded.
competition.lesson: A valid first submission and a full 16-task, solution-blind replay were more valuable than model complexity. Four materially different 0.822 packages and six null levers support treating ~0.001 score gaps as session noise, not strategy.

lanes.title: Offline screens, rejected branches, and held work

nodes.title: Official demo + public design review
nodes.summary: Reviewed the official demo, A-to-Z guide, and dynamic AutoML starter for schema discovery, validators, anti-loop prompts, fallback submission, and package layout.

nodes.title: Custom packages v1-v3
nodes.summary: Synthetic smoke tests passed, but v1/v3 never called submit_predictions and v2 requested unavailable run_skill_script.

nodes.title: v4 extracted official demo
nodes.summary: Extracted the official demo package and preserved its known-submit tool structure; first completed agent session.

nodes.title: v5 proven-shell recovery
nodes.summary: Kept the official-style shell and supported-tool workflow; the validated retry completed, unlike an earlier generic 400 upload rejection.

nodes.title: v6 LR + HGB blend
nodes.summary: Schema-agnostic logistic-regression and histogram-gradient-boosting blend on the proven shell established the first 0.819 baseline.

nodes.title: v9 pick-best OOF selector
nodes.summary: Replaced blending with a 4-model LR/HGB/RF/ET OOF selector and pairwise interactions. Its 3-task local edge did not transfer.
nodes.score: Local 0.828 vs v6 0.826 on 3 tasks; public 0.819 (55045683)

nodes.title: v12 deterministic portfolio + bounded Pro freeroll
nodes.summary: Quick fallback plus CatBoost, LightGBM, ExtraTrees, logistic, rank-top-two, and rank-all candidates; bounded target-blind Pro stage. All 16 replay tasks passed output validation.

nodes.title: v13 target-blind JSON planner
nodes.summary: Strict one-family JSON DSL and deterministic executor gated against the actual best portfolio prediction. A 882-run audit retained one small specialist only.

nodes.title: v15 seed-bag + time cap
nodes.summary: Added small-task-only seed averaging and a wall-clock cap as runtime insurance; pre-registered as no expected score gain.

nodes.title: Exact public Gemini freeroll control
nodes.summary: Static, attributed extraction of Naji's public 0.823 notebook; unbounded Pro governance differed from v12 while the core portfolio was effectively the same.

nodes.title: Claude Sonnet model-only challenger
nodes.summary: Swapped the Pro model after removing unsupported sampling controls. The first run failed before execution; corrected retry was still pending in the latest records.

nodes.title: Standalone CatBoost specialist
nodes.summary: Native-categorical CatBoost performed well on larger tasks but was weak on small tasks, so it was not uploaded as a default.

nodes.title: AutoGluon and Mitra screens
nodes.summary: AutoGluon tied the CatBoost specialist at higher dependency cost; Mitra was 28x-173x slower and hit memory limits.

nodes.title: v8 feature-family ablations
nodes.summary: Broad features regressed; numeric transforms were unstable; the adaptive gate gained slightly on replay but its agent never called submit_predictions.

nodes.title: v10 LLM plan with wrong-level gate
nodes.summary: The feature gate was sound inside the script but the agent still offered a known-weak CatBoost candidate to final selection, including on no-op plans.

nodes.title: v11 gated native-CatBoost candidate
nodes.summary: A measured synthetic categorical win and 0.003 OOF margin did not generalize to hidden sessions.

nodes.title: Six-lever saturation audit
nodes.summary: Candidate selection, LLM planning, seed averaging, CatBoost tuning, pseudo-labelling, and an extra gated model all had null, negligible, or negative evidence against the portfolio.
nodes.score: No reliable route from 0.822 to about 0.826+

nodes.title: Bounded H2O AutoML probe
nodes.summary: Recorded backlog option; local Java was unavailable and no isolated Kaggle diagnostic is recorded.
